title: From Bytes to Biases: Investigating the Cultural Self-Perception of Large Language Models
reasoning: The study focuses on evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) against the nine societal dimensions of the GLOBE project, which are cultural and societal values (e.g., Power Distance, Assertiveness). While the paper mentions moral foundations and religious bias in its literature review of existing studies, its own experimental component and analysis do not involve benchmarking religion, faith, or ethical/moral frameworks.
